# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

The ZQM team takes security seriously. We appreciate your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings.

To report a security issue, please use the [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/ZQM-Computing/security/advisories/new) feature for public repositories, or contact the maintainers directly for sensitive disclosures.

Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark: |

## Security Hardening

- All dependencies are monitored via Dependabot
- CI includes security scanning where applicable
- Secrets are managed via environment variables and GitHub Secrets

## Attribution

We follow responsible disclosure and will credit reporters who provide valid security findings.
